heading.en: Capitals in line with profit shares

hook.en: Partners often agree that capitals should be in the same ratio as profits. After admission, someone may need to bring cash and someone may take some out.
hook.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳಗಳು ಲಾಭದ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲೇ ಇರಬೇಕೆಂದು ಪಾಲುದಾರರು ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪ್ರವೇಶದ ನಂತರ ಕೆಲವರು ಹಣ ತರಬೇಕು, ಕೆಲವರು ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು.

objectives.en: Adjust old partners' capitals on the basis of the new partner's capital
Find the new partner's capital from old partners' capitals

narration.en: Partners often agree that capitals should be in the same ratio as profits. After admission, someone may need to bring cash and someone may take some out. Let us calculate who brings and who withdraws.
narration.kn: ಬಂಡವಾಳಗಳು ಲಾಭದ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲೇ ಇರಬೇಕೆಂದು ಪಾಲುದಾರರು ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪ್ರವೇಶದ ನಂತರ ಕೆಲವರು ಹಣ ತರಬೇಕು, ಕೆಲವರು ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು. ಯಾರು ತರಬೇಕು, ಯಾರು ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಹಾಕೋಣ.

title.en: Old capitals based on the new partner's capital

body.en: Total capital of the new firm = new partner's capital × reciprocal of his share. Each old partner's required capital = total × his new share. Compare with his adjusted capital (after goodwill, revaluation and reserves): a shortfall is brought in cash, an excess is withdrawn or credited to his current account.
body.kn: ಹೊಸ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಬಂಡವಾಳ × ಅವನ ಪಾಲಿನ ವ್ಯುತ್ಕ್ರಮ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಒಟ್ಟು × ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲು. ಕೊರತೆಯನ್ನು ತರಬೇಕು, ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿಯನ್ನು ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು.

narration.en: Total capital of the new firm = new partner's capital × reciprocal of his share. Each old partner's required capital = total × his new share. Compare with his adjusted capital (after goodwill, revaluation and reserves): a shortfall is brought in cash, an excess is withdrawn or credited to his current account.
narration.kn: ಹೊಸ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಬಂಡವಾಳ × ಅವನ ಪಾಲಿನ ವ್ಯುತ್ಕ್ರಮ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಒಟ್ಟು × ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲು. ಕೊರತೆಯನ್ನು ತರಬೇಕು, ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿಯನ್ನು ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು.

title.en: New partner's capital based on old capitals

body.en: Add the adjusted capitals of old partners and divide by their combined new share to get the total capital; the new partner's capital = total × his share.
body.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿದ ಬಂಡವಾಳಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಅವರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲಿನಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ; ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಒಟ್ಟು × ಅವನ ಪಾಲು.

narration.en: Add the adjusted capitals of old partners and divide by their combined new share to get the total capital; the new partner's capital = total × his share.
narration.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ಪಾಲುದಾರರ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿದ ಬಂಡವಾಳಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಅವರ ಒಟ್ಟು ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲಿನಿಂದ ಭಾಗಿಸಿ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ; ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಒಟ್ಟು × ಅವನ ಪಾಲು.

problem.en: A and B share 3:2. Their adjusted capitals are ₹1,80,000 and ₹1,40,000. C is admitted for a 1/5 share (taken in the old ratio) and brings ₹80,000. Capitals are to be in the new ratio. Find the cash to be brought in or withdrawn.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A and B share 3:2. Their adjusted capitals are ₹1,80,000 and ₹1,40,000. C is admitted for a 1/5 share (taken in the old ratio) and brings ₹80,000. Capitals are to be in the new ratio. Find the cash to be brought in or withdrawn.
Team quiz. Discuss in your teams and give one answer per team.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ತಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

points.en: Total capital = new partner's capital ÷ his share.
points.kn: ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ÷ ಅವನ ಪಾಲು.

points.en: Required capital = total capital × new share.
Shortfall is brought in; excess is withdrawn or put in the current account.
points.kn: ಕೊರತೆ ತರಬೇಕು; ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು ಅಥವಾ ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ.

homework.en: Prepare the capital accounts for the worked example showing cash brought in and withdrawn.

narration.en: Recap. Total capital = new partner's capital ÷ his share. Required capital = total capital × new share. Shortfall is brought in; excess is withdrawn or put in the current account.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲುದಾರನ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ÷ ಅವನ ಪಾಲು. ಅಗತ್ಯ ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಒಟ್ಟು × ಹೊಸ ಪಾಲು. ಕೊರತೆ ತರಬೇಕು; ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು ಅಥವಾ ಚಾಲ್ತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೆ.
